name: Dark
description: Moderate to strong saturation of colour with a very dark tone. Stone appears near-black; blue visible only under strong direct light.

name: Deep
description: Moderate to strong saturation of colour with a medium dark to dark tone. Clearly blue but noticeably dark.

name: Vivid
description: Vivid saturation of colour with medium to medium dark tone. The finest and most valuable intensity of colour for blue sapphire.

name: Intense
description: Moderate saturation of colour with a medium light tone. Bright, open blue but less vivid than Royal Blue.

name: Medium Intense
description: Moderate saturation of colour with a light tone. Pleasant, open blue with noticeable desaturation.

name: Light
description: Slightly greyish or brownish saturation of colour with a light tone. Soft blue, clearly fading toward colourless.

name: Very Light
description: Greyish colour with a very light tone, near colourless. Minimal blue visible — mostly a faint tint.
